[SWS_CM_00142] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Mini- mum Send Interval monitoring for Triggers
⌈
If the configured Minimum Send Inter-
val (ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement.minimumSendInterval) of a trig-
ger has the value 0, the Minimum Send Interval monitoring shall not be active for the
corresponding trigger, i.e., ara::com will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping trans-
mission requests. For each Trigger of a ServiceInterfaceDeployment (or the
associated Event), 0 shall be the default value for the corresponding ServiceInter-
faceDeploymentElement.minimumSendInterval. This means that unless Ser-
viceInterfaceDeploymentElement.minimumSendInterval for a given event
is explicitly configured to be > 0, the Tx rate is not limited by ara::com.
⌋
